title.en: First 10 human ESD procedures under supervision

description.en: Completion of the first 10 human ESD procedures under direct supervision by an ESD-proficient endoscopist.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for first 10 human esd procedures under supervision but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs first 10 human esd procedures under supervision independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches first 10 human esd procedures under supervision to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of source-canonical ESGE ESD 2019 recommendations into trainee-assessable units. ESD 2019 does not enumerate competencies as separate objects; this frame is Evideris's design.
